subject: Medigen: Commercial & Host Access Request for Private Deployment — decision needed
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@medigen.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Ella Cho <ella.cho@medigen.ai>, security@medigen.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment - commercial & access ask

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Medigen is prepared to move forward with a private deployment in us-west-2 but we have three commercial / operational asks that are gating sign-off on our side: 

1) Data residency & key control: all customer production data must remain in-region (US). We need support for customer-managed KMS keys (bring-your-own-key) and proof that Redwood will not retain copies outside the tenancy.

2) Audit/forensics access: our security and compliance team requires timeboxed host-level access for a third-party SOC engagement — read access to disk snapshots and system logs during a 30-day audit window, plus a one-off 72-hour forensic debug window if an incident is discovered.

3) Commercial concession: because this is an early private deployment and Medigen is committing to a 3-year reserved capacity profile, we are requesting a 25% committed discount and a one-time onboarding credit to offset the integration effort.

I attached our audit requirements (Medigen_Audit_Reqs.pdf). Please advise what your legal/ops/security and commercial teams would need to approve the above. We can be flexible on some implementation details but the three items above are non-negotiable for our board.

Best,
Tom Reynolds
VP Product & Platforms | Medigen Therapeutics
Tom.Reynolds@medigen.ai

Attachment: Medigen_Audit_Reqs.pdf (pdf, 180KB)

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment - commercial & access ask — need decision on exceptions

Team,

Forwarding Medigen's request. Summary of asks: customer-managed KMS, timeboxed host-level audit access + one forensic window, and a 25% committed discount on a 3-year reserved contract. They labeled it "non-negotiable" for board approval.

Quick internal read: 
- Security/ops implications (Dev) — allowing read access to snapshots/logs and a limited forensic window is doable with strict controls, jump box auditing, and presigned snapshot exports, but it increases support burden and risk profile. See attached security_risk_memo.pdf and an initial pricing impact calc (deal_pricing_calc.xlsx).
- Commercial — 25% is outside our standard tiered discount bands for 3-year commitments; finance needs visibility.

Proposal (fast counter to present by EOD Wednesday):
A) Offer 18% committed discount + one-time onboarding credit (equivalent to 2 months) if they sign 3-year reserved capacity.
B) Grant a timeboxed audit access window: up to 90 days total (split across scheduled audit + one 72-hour forensic escalation) under strict conditions: scoped snapshot exports, monitored jump host with session recordings, pre-approved list of auditors, NDAs, and a support SOW for the forensic window billing.
C) Support customer-managed KMS only if key delivery and escrow meet our KMS policy; customer-supplied HSM is OK with a validated integration run by infra.

Required approvals to send counter and accept any host/access concession:
- Vivek: approval for any discount >15%
- Laura/legal: to approve host-level access clause and the audit guardrails
- Finance: to record revenue impact and commit to the reserved term

Attachments: deal_pricing_calc.xlsx, security_risk_memo.pdf

Can you weigh in with firm approvals or changes? I want to avoid multiple back-and-forths with Medigen — if we can get exec OK for the 18-20% band and legal to sign the access clause, we present it as our final position.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Head of Sales, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.com

Attachments: deal_pricing_calc.xlsx, security_risk_memo.pdf

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment - commercial & access ask — need decision on exceptions

Kim,

I support the proposed counter with small edits. Rationale: Medigen is a strategic early private deploy and a 3-year commit offsets much of the cost. If we present 18% now and keep a stretch approval for 20% with a short exec sign-off path, we can close quickly. Specifics I'd like: 
- Offer 18% standard; up to 20% available with Vivek sign-off.
- Limit the total audit access to 90 days (including the forensic window) but require their auditors to be named ahead of time and onboarded.
- For the 72-hour forensic window, require an SOW that bills at our hourly dev-ops rate after the first 8 hours.

Also, I recommend we add a clause: any access to persistent disk or root-level snapshots must be executed by Redwood personnel (exported snapshot shared with their auditors) — we don't give direct SSH or console access to customer teams. That protects us operationally.

Deal impact captured in deal_pricing_calc.xlsx. Deal id MDG-2026-042. Happy to present the counter with Laura's legal language included.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, dev_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment - commercial & access ask — need decision on exceptions

Team,

After reviewing the summary and the risk memo: I authorize the following exceptions for Medigen, conditional on legal/ops guardrails being signed-off and finance recording the revenue commitment under MDG-2026-042: 

1) Commercial: approve up to 20% committed discount on a 3-year reserved contract. Anything above 20% requires CTO/CEO-level approval.
2) Audit/access: approve a timeboxed access regime (total 90 days across scheduled audits and one forensic window). No direct SSH/console access for external auditors — Redwood will execute snapshot exports and provide read-only artifacts. Forensic window: one 72-hour window where Redwood can enable additional session logs; any live debugging beyond the initial 8 hours will be billable per SOW.
3) KMS: permit customer-managed keys provided integration passes our infra security checklist and keys are provisioned via supported KMS/HSM.

Next steps: Laura/legal to draft the access clause and SOW language; Dev to outline the operational runbook and required engineering support hours; Kimberly/Ben to send the counter to the customer with these conditions. Please cc me on the counter.

Regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Revenue & Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
